about.name: Sourabh Kumar
about.about: Staff-level backend engineer with 9.5 years of experience designing and delivering distributed systems, fintech platforms, and AI-powered products. Deep expertise in Golang, cloud-native architecture, microservices, and agentic AI workflows. Proven ability to lead technical strategy, drive system-wide performance improvements, and scale engineering teams. Experienced in building high-throughput, low-latency systems on Kubernetes, Kafka, and Google Cloud infrastructure.

description: Architected and delivered Brevo Data Layer, an agentic analytics platform on CubeJS enabling natural language querying of business data; integrated AG-UI, MCP, and CopilotKit for streaming responses with built-in query validation and dynamic visualizations (line, bar, pie, donut, tabular).

Embedded GitHub Copilot CLI into the engineering workflow, reducing vulnerability fix cycles from 2 hours to 15 minutes, cutting test generation time by 75%, and automating release and rollback PR creation.
Designed and implemented a distributed infrastructure overhaul that improved system throughput by 30% and reduced cloud operational costs across production services.
Developed a company-wide unified observability system incorporating correlation ID propagation, structured logging, and alerting thresholds, reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR) by 40%.
Defined and enforced platform-wide API security standards including signed URL implementation for time-limited, secure resource access.
Led technical design reviews and architecture decisions across multiple backend services; provided engineering mentorship to a team of 8 engineers, reducing onboarding time by 25%.
Collaborated with product and business stakeholders on R&D initiatives, contributing to a 15% improvement in market competitiveness through new product capabilities.
Led end-to-end technical design and delivery of fintech platform features, owning architecture from requirements through production.
Architected and published a reusable Golang validation library adopted across multiple internal services, reducing duplicated logic and maintenance overhead.
Established automated testing frameworks and code quality gates, significantly improving release confidence and reducing production defect rates.
Partnered with cross-functional stakeholders to align backend architecture with product strategy and compliance requirements.
Led migration of legacy PHP monolith components to Golang microservices, reducing technical debt and service coupling.
Optimized critical API paths, achieving p95 latency under 3 seconds on high-traffic fintech endpoints.
Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, improving deployment frequency and system stability.
Developed and optimized content management features using Angular 8 and CodeIgniter; managed delivery milestones from design to release.
Designed database schemas and REST API contracts for enterprise applications; built a role-based CMS using Angular and Laravel.
Built and maintained microservices for internal enterprise portals; integrated CyberArk PAM with applications via AutoIT scripting; refactored legacy code to improve maintainability and performance.

projects.title: Lyra
projects.description: Designed and published an open-source Go library for orchestrating dependent tasks as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) with automatic concurrency, type-safe result passing, and built-in cycle detection.
